title: As a lurker here for a while, I'm curious as to why so many here have the same recurring mallworld dreams?

classification.question_topic: Why many people report similar/recurring 'Mall World' dreams; whether shared locations/synchronized events imply simulation/shared dream; whether ancient people had similar dreams; why only some people experience them.
classification.skip_reason: No first-person dream narrative; post is speculative/questioning with only generalized descriptions of others' reports.

meta.author_theory: Mentions possible causes: nostalgia/fond mall memories; resemblance to cyberpunk megabuildings; malls as planned suburban solutions (Victor Gruen); wonders if shared features imply simulation/dream reality; asks if modern vs ancient phenomenon.

extraction.extraction_notes: Post contains only secondhand/generalized descriptions of commonly reported Mall World features (e.g., city-inside-building, neon/futuristic aesthetics, similar bathrooms, shared locations, earthquakes felt by multiple posters) but no extractable first-person dream episode to encode as locations/visits.
